title: [CLM-8] Stale identity-method references
description: Review finding CLM-8: Stale identity-method references (lens CLM). Location: spec/09-interop.md:22; spec/99-appendices.md:11. Fix: As proposed. 09:22 says "(`did:key` or `did:web`)", which contradicts the agora-did-methods decision (did:webvh default, did:plc/did:key opt-in). 09:32's example credential may stay `did:key`. Appendix A Identity row becomes "W3C DID Core; methods in rows below" (the rows at 99:31-33 already list them). Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
